create_linear_probe_classifier: create a LinearProbe classifier with a given feature dimension and number of classes
build_linear_probe_forward: build a forward pass through the LinearProbe classifier to get class logits
evaluate_linear_probe_accuracy: evaluate a linear probe on a validation set and return accuracy and average loss
run_linear_probe_with_amp: run the linear probe evaluation with automatic mixed precision enabled on CUDA
test_linear_probe_cross_entropy: test the linear probe evaluation using cross entropy loss on a validation dataloader
